hardware_opportunity_model.grouping: row-bounded consecutive W positions; groups never cross B, H-row, or timestep boundaries
hardware_opportunity_model.source_service: at most one source channel from each bank per cycle
hardware_opportunity_model.output_blocking: ceil(output_channels/96), with physical tail lanes charged
hardware_opportunity_model.source_issue_cycle_equation: for each K-group and output block, maximum selected-union source count over the eight banks
hardware_opportunity_model.source_product_equation: selected signed source bits times exact output_channels
hardware_opportunity_model.physical_product_slot_equation: source_issue_cycles times 8 banks times 96 lanes times K contexts
hardware_opportunity_model.weight_hypothesis: signed INT8, one exact matrix load per sample, numeric qualification open
hardware_opportunity_model.serialized_integrated_cycle_equation: weight DMA transactions + current/candidate activation selector transactions + choice metadata writes + group descriptors + source issue cycles + chosen nonzero parent-output seed vector reads + final vector commits
hardware_opportunity_model.qualification: deterministic conservative opportunity model; no RTL, numeric, SRAM-port, timing, power, or system-speedup admission

capacity_model.spatial_input_parent_state: (tile_w+1)*ceil(input_channels/8) bytes for up row plus left vector
capacity_model.temporal_input_parent_state: tile_h*tile_w*ceil(input_channels/8) bytes for prior-timestep input tile
capacity_model.qualification: byte capacity only; macro shape, ports, banking and physical timing open

transaction_model.activation_vector_beats: ceil(ceil(input_channels/8)/32) independently for every current and valid candidate vector
transaction_model.parent_output_seed_transactions: one per selected nonzero parent per 96-output block
transaction_model.final_commit_transactions: one per destination vector per 96-output block
transaction_model.source_bank_read_transactions: selected K-group union sources times output blocks
transaction_model.group_descriptor_transactions: one per row-bounded K-group per output block

address_schedule.qualification: symbolic exact schedule metadata; concrete SRAM/DRAM base addresses and macro ports open

m39_amdahl_model.qualification: Amdahl ceilings and exact cycle gates only; no M63 or M39 value is a measured system speedup
